description: This is a 3D model preview of a classic-style nightstand or end table, crafted from rich, dark reddish-brown wood with a visible grain. The piece features a rectangular top with subtly rounded edges. Below the top, there are two functional drawers, each adorned with elegant, curved brass-colored pull handles. The nightstand is supported by four sturdy legs, each featuring a tapered design with carved or turned detailing, giving it a refined and traditional appearance. The entire piece has a polished finish, reflecting light softly and highlighting the wood's texture.
